places.name: State Hermitage Museum (Winter Palace)
places.ai_summary: One of the world's largest and oldest museums, showcasing art and cultural artifacts in the historic Winter Palace.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission is 30 minutes before closing.

places.best_time_to_visit: Morning hours to avoid crowds
places.place_tip: Purchase tickets online to skip the queue.

places.name: Peterhof Palace and Garden
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage site, this grand palace is known for its stunning gardens and fountains.

opening_hours.notes: The garden is open year-round, the palace is closed on Mondays from November to March.

places.best_time_to_visit: Late spring to early autumn for garden views
places.place_tip: Take the hydrofoil from Saint Petersburg for a scenic route.

places.name: Church of the Savior on Spilled Blood
places.ai_summary: A famous church known for its intricate mosaics and vibrant onion domes, built on the site where Emperor Alexander II was assassinated.
places.name_english: Church of the Savior on Spilled Blood

opening_hours.notes: The church is closed for services, which are usually held in the mornings.

places.best_time_to_visit: Early morning or late afternoon to avoid crowds
places.place_tip: Don't miss the stunning mosaics inside the church.

places.name: Saint Isaac's Cathedral
places.ai_summary: The largest cathedral in Russia, known for its impressive dome and stunning interior mosaics.

opening_hours.notes: The cathedral is closed for services, which are usually held in the mornings.

places.best_time_to_visit: Late afternoon for sunset views
places.place_tip: Climb to the colonnade for a panoramic view of the city.

places.name: Catherine Palace and Park (Pushkin)
places.ai_summary: A Rococo masterpiece and former royal residence, famous for its opulent architecture and the Amber Room.

opening_hours.notes: The park is open year-round, the palace is closed on Mondays from November to March.

places.best_time_to_visit: Summer for the full experience of the gardens
places.place_tip: Visit the Amber Room, a reconstruction of the original 18th-century room decorated in amber panels.

places.name: Nevsky Prospekt
places.ai_summary: The main avenue in Saint Petersburg, known for its historic buildings, shops, and cafes.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored on foot. Many shops and cafes have varying hours.

places.best_time_to_visit: Anytime, but evenings are lively with lights and activities
places.place_tip: Try local pastries at one of the many bakeries along the avenue.

places.name: Peter and Paul Fortress
places.ai_summary: The original citadel of Saint Petersburg, now a museum, with a stunning cathedral and views of the city.

opening_hours.notes: The fortress is open year-round, but some exhibitions may be closed in winter.

places.best_time_to_visit: Late afternoon for sunset views over the Neva River
places.place_tip: Visit the Peter and Paul Cathedral within the fortress for its impressive interior.
places.address: Peter and Paul Fortress, Sankt-Peterburg, Russia, 197022

places.name: Mariinsky Theatre
places.ai_summary: A famous opera and ballet theatre, known for its beautiful architecture and cultural performances.

opening_hours.notes: Check the schedule for performance times. The box office opens at 10:00 AM.

places.best_time_to_visit: Evenings when performances are held
places.place_tip: Book tickets in advance, especially for popular performances.

places.name: Russian Museum
places.ai_summary: The largest depository of Russian art in Saint Petersburg, featuring works from the 10th century to the present.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission is 30 minutes before closing.

places.best_time_to_visit: Afternoons are less crowded
places.place_tip: Don't miss the Mikhailovsky Palace, which is part of the museum complex.

places.name: Fabergé Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum dedicated to the works of Carl Fabergé, including the famous Fabergé eggs.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission is 1 hour before closing.

places.best_time_to_visit: Weekdays are less crowded
places.place_tip: Join a guided tour for detailed insights into the exhibits.

places.name: Kazan Cathedral
places.ai_summary: A magnificent cathedral known for its impressive colonnade and beautiful interior.

opening_hours.notes: The cathedral is closed for services, which are usually held in the mornings.

places.best_time_to_visit: Midday for the best light for photos
places.place_tip: Visit the iconostasis, a masterpiece of Russian religious art.

places.name: Canal Cruises (Neva River, Fontanka, Moyka)
places.ai_summary: Cruises that offer a unique view of Saint Petersburg's architecture and bridges from the water.

opening_hours.notes: Cruises operate from late April to early October. Check the schedule in advance.

places.best_time_to_visit: White Nights season (mid-June to mid-July) for extended daylight
places.place_tip: Bring a light jacket, it can be chilly on the water even in summer.
places.address: Neva River, Fontanka, Moyka, Sankt-Peterburg, Russia

places.name: Palace Square
places.ai_summary: The central city square of Saint Petersburg, featuring the iconic Alexander Column and the General Staff Building.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late evening to avoid crowds.

places.best_time_to_visit: Early morning for sunrise views and fewer people
places.place_tip: Visit the State Hermitage Museum located on the square.

places.name: Bronze Horseman Statue
places.ai_summary: A famous equestrian statue of Peter the Great, located on Senate Square.

opening_hours.notes: Best viewed in the early morning or late evening.

places.best_time_to_visit: Sunrise or sunset for great lighting
places.place_tip: The statue is located near the Senate Square, which is a great spot for photos.

places.name: Yusupov Palace
places.ai_summary: A historic palace on the Moika River, known for its beautiful architecture and interior design.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission is 1 hour before closing.

places.best_time_to_visit: Weekdays are less crowded
places.place_tip: Explore the palace's beautiful gardens along the Moika River.

places.name: St Nicholas Naval Cathedral
places.ai_summary: A baroque naval cathedral with a striking blue and white exterior, located on the Kryukov Canal.

opening_hours.notes: The cathedral is closed for services, which are usually held in the mornings.

places.best_time_to_visit: Midday for the best light for photos
places.place_tip: The cathedral's bell tower offers a great view of the city.

places.name: Summer Garden
places.ai_summary: A beautiful and historic garden in the city center, perfect for a leisurely stroll.

opening_hours.notes: The garden is open year-round, but the best time to visit is from late spring to early autumn.

places.best_time_to_visit: Late spring for blooming flowers and mild weather
places.place_tip: Check out the sculptures and the fountain in the garden.

places.ai_summary: A museum ship and former Russian battleship, now a symbol of the October Revolution.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission is 1 hour before closing.

places.best_time_to_visit: Afternoons are less crowded
places.place_tip: Explore the deck and the various exhibits on board.

places.name: Erarta Museum of Contemporary Art
places.ai_summary: The first and only state museum of contemporary art in Russia, featuring a vast collection of modern Russian art.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission is 1 hour before closing.

places.best_time_to_visit: Weekdays are less crowded
places.place_tip: Check out the museum shop for unique souvenirs.

places.name: Kunstkamera
places.ai_summary: The first museum in Russia, founded by Peter the Great, displaying a unique collection of curiosities and artifacts.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission is 30 minutes before closing.

places.best_time_to_visit: Afternoons are less crowded
places.place_tip: Don't miss the mummified remains and other unique exhibits.
